surface_mechanism_description: NH3 plasma reduces Ru(EtCp)2, which interacts with the surface and facilitates the deposition of ruthenium without forming an interfacial metal oxide layer. The NH3 plasma likely weakens the Ru-EtCp bond and promotes the formation of volatile compounds with the ligands in Ru(EtCp)2.
intermediate_species: volatile compounds with ligands in Ru(EtCp)2
evidence: It is reasonable to postulate that the lone-pair electron in the NH3 will interact with the ruthenium in Ru(EtCp)2 and weakens the Ru-~EtCp! bond. Also, the excited species in NH3 plasma will help the reaction by easily making volatile compounds with the ligands in Ru(EtCp)2.
